messages:
incident-bot: [P0] Alert: spike in 500s for /v1/generate (region: eu-west). Severity auto-escalated to P0. @oncall has been paged :rotating_light:
alex_sre: i'm on it — looking at dashboards now
alex_sre: grafana shows errors start ~ 08:12 UTC, error rate ~ 42% for gen endpoints, latency up for a subset of customers
maya_support: receiving multiple sev chats from a few enterprise customers, one mentions chat responses returning empty arrays
chris_ml: quick hypothesis — smart routing fallback kicked to an incompatible variant. saw similar in past with version override rules
ben_prod: can you confirm whether routing policy changed? I didn't see any config deployments in the last hour
sophia_eng: checking control-plane audit logs... gimme 10s
alex_sre: logs (excerpt):
```
2025-06-03T08:11:53Z control-plane routing:update user=auto-rollout policy=smart-routing id=policy-782
2025-06-03T08:12:05Z service router: fallback trigger model=redwood-gen-v3 -> variant=embed-quantized-v1 reason=incompatible_schema
2025-06-03T08:12:06Z runtime: 500 response schema-mismatch
```
alex_sre: that looks like a routing rule pushed a hard override to prefer a cheaper variant that only supports embeddings. results in gen/chat requests being routed to an embed-only runtime -> 500
chris_ml: confirmed — the variant chosen doesn't support chat/instruct decode path. should have been a gen-compat variant
maya_support: customer-impact: 14 orgs reported 500s, two flagged as critical (chat flows disrupted). logging their case IDs and contacting CS
ben_prod: did anyone touch the variant-mapping table? that's usually in the rollout service (rollout-svc)
sophia_eng: audit shows automated recommendation from optimize-job #243 pushed a change to rollout-svc to reduce cost for low-traffic models. it added a fallback entry: "prefer_variant: embed-quantized-v1" for model redwood-gen-v3 in eu-west
alex_sre: ok mitigation plan: 1) add a temporary routing override to bypass smart-routing for gen/chat traffic in eu-west and route to redwood-gen-v3:chat-compat 2) rollback the optimize-job change 3) postmortem after full recovery
chris_ml: I can prepare the rollback payload. will need help applying override (requires infra-admin)
ben_prod: tagging @deploy-bot to apply emergency routing override
deploy-bot: Received emergency job request #E-8943, awaiting approval from two approvers
alex_sre: i'm approving now, @sophia_eng can you approve?
sophia_eng: approved. running emergency override now
sophia_eng: command run:
```
rwctl routing override create --scope eu-west --match-path /v1/generate --match-model redwood-gen-v3 --route-to redwood-gen-v3:chat-compat --ttl 1h --reason "emergency: embed fallback caused 500s"
```
deploy-bot: override created id=ovr-20250603-01 ttl=3600s. Propagating to edge routers :rocket:
alex_sre: watching metrics... errors dropping in the next couple mins, latency normalizing
chris_ml: rolling back optimize-job #243 in rollout-svc to remove prefer_variant rule
sophia_eng: rollback submitted: rollout-svc change id=rb-892, will take ~30s to reconcile
maya_support: CS update drafted. telling impacted customers we've applied a temporary routing override and are doing a config rollback. ETA for full restoration 15 mins
ben_prod: quick check — any risk this override will route to a variant with incompatible weights/kvcache?
chris_ml: chat-compat variant uses same model weights with a chat decoding ABI, should be safe. embed-quantized was the incompatibility
alex_sre: monitoring for errors: no new 500s for affected customers in last 2m. marking incident as mitigated but keep P0 until rollback reconciles
maya_support: continuing customer outreach, asking for any remaining error traces
chris_ml: follow-up action items: - disable auto-apply of optimize-job suggestions to rollout-svc until we add variant compatibility checks - add unit test for routing policies to detect embed-vs-gen mismatches - one-hour postmortem meeting at 09:30 UTC
sophia_eng: creating task cards and assigning: OPT-457 (block auto-apply), TEST-102 (routing policy unit tests), PMT-11 (postmortem doc)
alex_sre: handing incident to chris_ml for postmortem and follow-up. i'm staying on for 10m watch then will sign off
chris_ml: ack. i'll compile timeline and impact numbers. initial estimate: 14 customers affected, peak 42% error rate, duration ~18 minutes until override took effect
maya_support: adding full list of customer case IDs to the incident doc and flagging two for executive follow-up
deploy-bot: rollback rb-892 completed and reconciled across control-plane at 08:40 UTC
alex_sre: thanks everyone. moving to monitoring. will reopen if regressions seen. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P0 -> Mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem required.
